Konstantinos Kolokythas | chairman = Dimitrios Pantiskos | manager = [[Elias Charalambous]] | league = [[Super League Greece]] | season = [[2025–26 Super League Greece|2025–26]] | position = [[Super League Greece]], 6th of 14 | current = 2025–26 Levadiakos F.C. season | website = {{URL|https://www.levadiakosfc.gr/|levadiakosfc.gr}} | pattern_la1 = _levadiakos2526h | pattern_b1 = _levadiakos2526h | pattern_ra1 = _levadiakos2526h | pattern_sh1 = _levadiakos2526h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 005754 | body1 = 005754 | rightarm1 = 005754 | shorts1 = 005754 | socks1 = 005754 | pattern_la2 = _levadiakos2526a | pattern_b2 = _levadiakos2526a | pattern_ra2 = _levadiakos2526a | pattern_sh2 = _levadiakos2526a | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Levadiakos Football Club''' (officially romanized: ''Levadeiakos'' {{langx|el|ΠΑΕ Λεβαδειακός}}) is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club that plays in the [[Super League Greece]]. Based in [[Livadeia]], Greece, the club was promoted to the [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]], forerunner of the Super League, after ten seasons in minor divisions in the 2005–06 season, as runner-up of the [[Football League (Greece)|Football League]] in 2004–05.{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/grk05.html |title=Greece 2004/05 |publisher=Rsssf.com |access-date=2011-12-28 |archive-date=2022-07-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220712011630/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/grk05.html |url-status=live }} It was then relegated to the Beta Ethniki again in 2006–07{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/grk06.html |title=Greece 2005/06 |publisher=Rsssf.com |date=2006-08-20 |access-date=2011-12-28 |archive-date=2022-07-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220712011628/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/grk06.html |url-status=live }} and returned to the top tier in 2007–08. The club finished one level above relegation that year but was relegated back to the second division by finishing [[2009-10 Super League Greece|14th in 2009–10]].{{cite web|url=http://www.enet.gr/?i=news.el.article&id=152829|title=Relegation with victory for Levadiakos|publisher=enet.gr|language=el|access-date=18 April 2010|archive-date=19 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181019122014/http://www.enet.gr/?i=news.el.article&id=152829|url-status=live}} From 2011-2012 to 2018-2019 has played in Super League 1.The club most recently won promotion back into Super League Greece after winning the [[Super League Greece 2]] in [[2023-24 Super League Greece 2|2023–24]]. The next season the team played again in Super League 1 but finished in 14th place and were relegated. The subsequent season they won the Super League 2 and returned to Super League 1."}}
